questions.question: Three of the following four words are alike in a certain way and one is different. Select the odd one.
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is :-

Lungs, Heart, Liver are internal parts of human body.

But,

Nose is an external part of human body it is different from other three alternatives.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Nose".**

questions.question: In the following question, select the odd word from the given alternatives.
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:

Litre is a measuring unit of Volume.

Similarly,

Second is a measuring unit of Time.

Ohm is a measuring unit of Resistance.

Pascal is a measuring unit of Pressure.

Whereas, 

The barometer is a device that is used to measure atmospheric pressure.

Hence, the correct answer is **Pressure : Barometer.**

questions.question: Four pair of words have been given, out of which three pairs are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the pair of words that is different.
Out of the following four words, three are alike in some way or the other and one is different. Identify the different word.
questions.solution:
**As per the given information:**

From all the above options:

1. **Guru Nanak **→ Guru Nanak was the founder of Sikhism and is the first of ten Sikh gurus.

2. **Bible **→ The bible is a collection of religious texts or sacred scriptures of Christianity.

3. **Quran **→ The Quran is a collection of religious texts or sacred scriptures of Islam.

4. **Ramayana **→ The Ramayana is a collection of lord ram's religious texts or sacred scriptures.

Here, Guru Nanak is different from other options.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Guru Nanak**"

questions.question: Find the odd one out:
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Option (1): Square → It is a **two-dimensional (2D)** shape.

Option (2): Triangle → It is a** two-dimensional **(2D)** **shape.

Option (3): Cube → It is a **three-dimensional** (3D) shape.

Option (4): Rectangle → It is a **two-dimensional** (2D) shape.

Therefore, '**Cube**' is odd.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option (3)**".

questions.question: Three out of four words given below belong to same category. Find the odd one out.
questions.solution:
We consider the given options:

Option 1) Church : It is a building used for worshiping. 

Option 2)** Clinic : It is a building used to treat patients.**

Option 3) Mosque : It is a building used for worshiping. 

Option 4) Temple : It is a building used for worshiping.

Hence, **Clinic **is the odd one out.

questions.question: In the following question, four pairs of words are given, out of which the word of three pairs bears a certain common relationship. Choose the pair in which the words are differently related.
questions.solution:
In option 1: Maize comes under Cereal.

In option 2: Tomato is a fruit and Potato is a vegetable.

In option 3: Books are found in Library.

In option 4: Students are found in Class.

All except option 2 follows the same relationship.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2.**

questions.question: Three of the following four words are alike in a certain way and one is different. Choose the odd one.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Option (1) Realme – A mobile manufacturing company from China.

Option (2) Nokia – A mobile manufacturing company from Finland.

**Option (3) Tesla – A tech and car manufacturing company from United States of America.**

Option (4) Samsung – A mobile manufacturing company from South Korea.

**Hence, All the given options follow the same logic except Tesla.**

questions.question: Select the odd word from the given alternatives.
questions.solution:
**Solution :**

The logic followed here is :

**1.** **Highlighter**: Highlighter is a type of writing device used to make attention to sections.

**2. Pen**: Pen is also a common writing instrument.

**3. Paper**: Paper is a material made of thin sheets that you use for writing.

**4. Pencil:** We all know that Pencil is also a common writing instrument.

We can clearly see that Highlighter, Pen and Pencil are the writing instruments but **Paper **is not a writing instrument.

Hence the correct answer is **"Paper".**
